_comment: Single source of truth for every number in the manuscript. Values are drawn from paper/results/metrics.json (the independent 450,589-event evaluation of the production model) and from the project's cascade / stress-test analyses. make_macros.py turns this file (plus figures_stats.json, produced by make_figures.py) into paper_macros.tex. NEVER hand-edit numbers in paper.tex.

test._comment: evaluation pool split by rng(7): 20% validation (threshold selection), 80% final test. All reported metrics AND figures use the final-test rows only (test_idx.npy).

per_class.note: population-weighted (selection-corrected) recall / precision / F1; argmax over the six classes

per_class_support._comment: number of FINAL-TEST events (of 360,472) carrying each observational label; matches the rows used for every reported metric

labelling._comment: label surgery performed by detectability-conditioned labelling, vs generation class

stress._comment: 30 unseen-parameter regimes (14.9M) + natural-population subset (4.5M) = 19.4M; macro-F1 is the natural-population subset

stress_regimes._comment: Per-regime stress-test numbers at the model's operating point, from results/stress_report.json. In-distribution ('natural') vs deliberately out-of-range (oor_*) regimes. Reported to replace the vague 'degradations are confined/near-fundamental' claim.

gap_matched._comment: P0.8 (reproducible): uniform vs nightly-gapped sampling at MATCHED visit counts on the SAME 120 events; only temporal placement differs. Wilson 95% CIs. Below ~20 visits/day both collapse (sparsity floor). Source: validation/gap_matched_density.py -> validation/gap_matched_result.json.

mass_ratio_regimes._comment: P1: completeness at the FIXED operating threshold, split by lens mass ratio q, on the frozen test. Aggregate NonPSPL completeness is dominated by stellar binaries; planet recovery degrades with q.

massregime_finetune._comment: Targeted fine-tune: warm-start from the shipped checkpoint, 6 epochs at lr 5e-5 on planetary-regime data (q in [1e-6,1e-3]); both models then scored on the SAME 45,176-event natural-mix set generated from an unseen seed base. Completeness at the fixed operating threshold. z from an unpaired normal approximation (conservative; per-event outcomes not retained for a paired test). Source: validation/modal_massregime_finetune.py.

hardregime_finetune._comment: Second fine-tune: 11 hard regimes (wide/wider/planet_wide, perhard, shortte, longte, faint, flatrich, lpvhard, planetary, planet_res), 164,390 events, 8 epochs at lr 5e-5 from the shipped checkpoint. Both models scored on the SAME eval sets from an unseen seed base, per class per regime. Source: validation/modal_hardregime_finetune.py.

cadence_experiment._comment: P0.5: matched-recipe comparison of the legacy 15-min F146 cadence vs the current GBTDS ~12-min rate. 12 shards (~90k events), 12 epochs, seed 20260720, trained from scratch per arm in isolated Modal containers. Source: validation/modal_cadence.py.

baselines._comment: Fieldable-baseline comparison on 9,000 freshly simulated events (3,600-event test). EVERY method receives the SAME data: one band (F146), all 6912 epochs. (An earlier version gave BinML the full curve and the baselines a 400-point downsample; equalising downward was rejected because 400 pts is below the sparsity floor where BinML fails outright.) Only the 5-parameter PSPL fit uses a thinned subset, a compute shortcut. Source: validation/baselines.py -> baselines_result.json.

inference._comment: measured on CPU, batch 1024, torch inference_mode; see make_data_figures notes

infra._comment: measured/recorded infrastructure numbers for the appendix

false_positive._comment: timing false positives = premature flags; missed planets = false negatives

_cascade_note: Cascade numbers are NOT stored here. make_macros.py reads them directly from validation/cascade_reproduce_result.json and fails if it is missing or its schema changed, so the manuscript cannot drift from the artifact.
_latency_note: Latency numbers are NOT stored here either. Like the cascade block they come from validation/cascade_reproduce_result.json via make_macros.py, so §4, the abstract and Figures 4-5 all read ONE artifact. A duplicated copy here is what produced two contradictory sets of latency statistics in an earlier draft.

prevalence_operating._comment: Referee issue 4: completeness ACHIEVABLE at 0.90 purity when the threshold is re-optimised for an assumed anomaly prevalence (frozen test artifact). The headline 0.879@0.908 exists only at the synthetic mixture's 5.6% prevalence.
